title: Whole Milk 1 gal

drivers.name: Price increase (5.1%)
drivers.evidence: Recent $4.56 week (2026-09-28) sold 94% of baseline; next week (2026-10-05) sold 57%. Historical promotions at lower discounts lifted sales, but no past sale at $4.56. Price effect inferred from recent drop.

drivers.name: Supplier delivery short warning
drivers.evidence: Planner note indicates supply risk. No past delivery issue at this store. Downside risk not captured in baseline. Added as conservative buffer.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 207.6. A 5.1% price increase to $4.56 (from $4.34) is a known demand-lowering driver. Historical data shows no promotion at this price point, but past promotions at lower discounts had median lifts of x1.5 (noise-adjusted x1.36). The recent week with $4.56 (2026-09-28) sold 195 units (x0.94 vs baseline), and the next week (2026-10-05) sold 119 (x0.57), suggesting a steep demand drop. The 5.1% increase likely caused a 20–30% demand drop. Supplier delivery short warning adds downside risk. No event or promotion is planned. The classical uplift model gives 1.00, but it ignores price effects. Adjust downward for price and supply risk.

brief:
PRODUCT: Whole Milk 1 gal | category Dairy | Store #12 (Austin, TX)
TARGET WEEK: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15 (5 weeks after the last week with sales data)

KNOWN PLAN FOR THE TARGET WEEK:
  events: none
  shelf price: 4.56 (+5.1% vs regular price 4.34)
  planner notes: Supplier warns of a short delivery

STATISTICAL BASELINE (exponential smoothing of recent sales; it ignores events, promotions and prices):
  median 207.6 | 5%-95%: 133.4 - 290.4 | 10%-90%: 156.2 - 281.2

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-22% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
